_doc: PERF s11 item 5: babel 307987276 Rubolhin by the Lake by DAY (hour 11), low views east (alt ~60-100 m, under the deck); ft0 = fartrees off. pe3-stream / pe3-pond: the wet hillside cells 1.4-1.7 km east (probe-eastwater: 0.4 m films at h 0.5-12.7 m, a 5 m pond at 9.5-11.4 m), looking back west.
